answer: An answer must cite at least 2 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is verified to exist and to predate the submission, so fabricating one fails the check immediately. Because the anchor index resolves every citation against the sparrow checkpoint, a farm has to read the ledger per identity, and the pigment audit keeps the resolved set. So the marginal impostor costs more than the marginal honest participant earns in 6 epochs. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
